story.fullStory:
Eric Clapton's "Wonderful Tonight" reached #16 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Wonderful Tonight" is a song written and performed by English singer Eric Clapton.

The ballad was included on Clapton's 1977 album Slowhand.

Clapton wrote the song on his 1974 Martin D-28 guitar about Pattie Boyd.

The song peaked at #16 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

Slowhand is the fifth solo studio album by Eric Clapton.
Released on 25 November 1977 by RSO Records, and titled after Clapton's nickname, it is one of his most commercially and critically successful studio albums.
